name: greenpulse
description: GreenPulse — Intelligent Swachhta & Sustainability Compliance Monitoring Platform (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:https --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
